content.comment_body: Good morning, I'm searching for a method to shorten the I/O state field text length shown on the display. Currently, the default is 8 characters, which is often excessive, as most text needed is just 'ON' or 'OFF'. When I/O states are shown, the fields can overlap, so being able to reduce the max length would enable more than two I/O states per display row. Is it possible to decrease the maximum I/O state field length? Thanks!
No, that's not possible. The field length is fixed at 8 characters, and these fields cannot overlap.

Hello [user_name], Could you clarify what you mean by 'Since I/O states can overlap'? If the ticker option is used in the message text module, you can display four I/O states (two alternating at a time) per line. Alternatively, if text isn't required, four available bar charts can be used instead on a single line. Best regards, [user_name]

Apologies, that was an error on my part. I meant 'can't overlap'. I know about the ticker option, but it would be much better if we could reduce the I/O state text length or allow overlap between states. Often, the I/O state is simply 'Yes/No', so the 8-character field is mostly unused.
Regardless, the limitation is that the text length remains fixed at 8 characters and cannot be adjusted. That's how it works.
True, but this could be put forward as a recommendation for future firmware releases...
Keep hoping... [company_name] has typically not prioritized user suggestions.
Hi, You can use a 2-character wide bargraph to show status information. Please refer to the attached example. Note: You can include a maximum of four bargraphs in one message text.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are frustrated that the I/O state field text length on the display cannot be changed from its fixed 8-character size. This results in unnecessary space usage, especially since most status texts are very short ('ON', 'OFF', etc.). Suggested workarounds, such as ticker text or bargraphs, only partially address the issue and highlight the lack of flexibility or user customization in display formatting.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want the ability to adjust or shorten the I/O state text fields, allowing more statuses to be shown in a single row for better space usage and screen organization.
